disclaimer.zh-TW: 範本只寫「要確認什麼」，規定會改，出發前請到官方網站確認並改成你們查到的內容。
disclaimer.en: This template lists what to confirm, not the rules themselves. Rules change: check the official sites and write down what you find.

- 駐紐西蘭台北經濟文化辦事處緊急電話：＿＿＿

body.en:

- Non-emergency police: ___

body.zh-TW:
- 確認插座型式與電壓，帶對的轉接頭
- 確認吹風機、電鍋等電器標示的電壓範圍，需要的話帶變壓器
- 露營車：確認營地電源線的接頭和車上的插座
body.en:
- Confirm the socket type and voltage and bring the right adapter
- Check the voltage range printed on hair dryers and cookers; bring a converter if needed
- Campervan: confirm the campsite power lead fits the van

body.zh-TW:
- 確認當地的小費習慣（餐廳、導覽、司機）
- 刷卡時店家問要不要用台幣結帳，選當地幣（NZD）
- 確認哪些地方要現金（部分營地、小鎮市集）
- 確認刷卡是否加收手續費
body.en:
- Confirm the local tipping custom (restaurants, tours, drivers)
- When asked to pay in your home currency, choose the local one (NZD)
- Confirm where cash is needed (some campsites, small-town markets)
- Confirm whether card surcharges apply

body.zh-TW:
- 確認靠左行駛與轉彎讓行規則
- 確認單線橋怎麼看讓行標誌（哪一方先行）
- 確認各類道路的限速；露營車實際常比速限慢
- 確認碎石路是否在租車保險範圍
- 確認冬季哪些山路需要雪鏈
- 開車時間抓寬一點：山路、觀景停車、補給

紐西蘭交通局（NZTA）https://www.nzta.govt.nz
body.en:
- Confirm keep-left driving and the give-way rules at turns
- Confirm how one-lane bridge signs show who gives way
- Confirm speed limits by road type; campervans usually drive slower
- Confirm whether gravel roads are covered by the rental insurance
- Confirm which mountain roads need chains in winter
- Allow extra time for winding roads, lookouts and supplies

NZ Transport Agency (NZTA) https://www.nzta.govt.nz

body.zh-TW:
- 確認自來水能不能生飲
- 營地與步道：確認水龍頭標示是否為飲用水，溪水要處理過才喝
body.en:
- Confirm whether tap water is drinkable
- At campsites and on tracks: check whether taps are marked drinkable; treat stream water

body.zh-TW:
- 確認入境卡上要申報的項目（食物、植物、動物製品、戶外用品）
- 登山鞋、帳篷、釣具要先清乾淨
- 不確定就申報；確認未申報的罰則

紐西蘭初級產業部（MPI）https://www.mpi.govt.nz
紐西蘭移民署 https://www.immigration.govt.nz
body.en:
- Confirm what the arrival card asks you to declare (food, plants, animal products, outdoor gear)
- Clean hiking boots, tents and fishing gear first
- When unsure, declare; confirm the penalties for not declaring

Ministry for Primary Industries (MPI) https://www.mpi.govt.nz
Immigration New Zealand https://www.immigration.govt.nz

body.zh-TW:
- 營地：Campermate、Rankers（確認是否支援離線）
- 天氣：MetService
- 路況：NZTA 的即時路況
- 離線地圖：出發前下載整趟範圍
body.en:
- Campsites: Campermate, Rankers (check offline support)
- Weather: MetService
- Roads: NZTA live road conditions
- Offline maps: download the whole route before you go

body.zh-TW:
## 自炊設備認證
- 確認車子是否有 self-contained 認證，以及各區自由露營的規定（各區不同、常改）

## 營地類型
- 假日公園：有電、水、廁所、廚房，旺季要訂
- 保育部（DOC）營地：便宜、設施少，部分要訂
- 自由露營：限制多，確認當地規定

## 每天的例行
- 接電、加水、倒灰水與黑水、煮飯：抵達營地抓日落前 1 小時
- 傾倒站大約每 2–3 天一次，山區加油站稀疏

紐西蘭保育部（DOC）https://www.doc.govt.nz
body.en:
## Self-contained certification
- Confirm whether the van is certified self-contained and the freedom-camping rules in each area (they differ and change)

## Kinds of campsites
- Holiday parks: power, water, toilets, kitchen; book in peak season
- Conservation (DOC) campsites: cheap, basic, some need booking
- Freedom camping: many restrictions; check the local rules

## The daily routine
- Power, water, grey and black water, cooking: arrive about an hour before sunset
- Dump stations roughly every 2–3 days; fuel is sparse in the mountains

Department of Conservation (DOC) https://www.doc.govt.nz
